value.rationale: The precise local analytic algebra and Zariski-local product, for every singular stratum of an infinite naturally studied graph-hypersurface family, reveal absence of higher-order moduli not implied by its familiar tangent cones. This is a substantive structural strengthening of general rank/multiplicity theorems, permits all-order local calculations, and identifies smooth-factor dimensions even on deep singular intersections. The already-known multiplicities and singular-support counts are secondary consequences and are not independently advanced as discoveries.
